title: Watch-Agent: Mechanical Horology Database
description: Relational database of mechanical and automatic wristwatch calibers, winding mechanisms, and certification tests.

certified_chronometers_and_divers.title: Chronometer & Diver Test Matrix
certified_chronometers_and_divers.sql: SELECT w.brand, w.model_name, m.caliber_number, m.winding_mechanism, m.frequency_vph, t.standard, t.accuracy_min_spd, t.accuracy_max_spd, t.water_resistance_bar, t.magnetic_resistance_gauss FROM watches w JOIN movements m ON w.caliber_id = m.caliber_id JOIN watch_tests t ON w.watch_id = t.watch_id ORDER BY w.brand, w.model_name;
